briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and Anthropic Claude 4.5 intensify US-China AGI competition as compute shortages bite

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate model releases amid regulatory scrutiny. Funding remains robust while safety concerns mount over multi-agent systems. DialectForge gains traction in enterprise pilots.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI ships o4 with 2.1T parameters and native video reasoning. Anthropic releases Claude 4.5 Opus while Google DeepMind unveils Gemini 3. Meta open-sources Llama 4 405B. xAI and DeepSeek push new inference optimizations.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent, automotive, and BCI use cases.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: TSMC ramps 2nm production for NVIDIA Blackwell. Microsoft announces $15B data center expansion in Texas. AMD and Intel report new AI accelerator tapeouts for 2027.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will a single lab achieve AGI-level performance before 2028 or will the race fragment into regional blocs?
